summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of SVRE Holdings Ltd. via a merger with its BVI subsidiary. Consideration comprised $300 million in cash and 126,849,307 USAR shares. The merger closed on September 3, 2026, following amendments to the April 2026 agreement. The transaction expands USAR's rare earth assets. Board recommendation and advisors are not disclosed. Structural notes include BVI merger mechanics and stock consideration to SVRE shareholders. Watch for post-closing integration, share overhang from issued stock, and potential dilution impact on USAR's public float.
